documents.title: Generative AI in the Classroom
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guidance applying the Student Code of Conduct academic integrity policy to AI (unauthorized resource, plagiarism if uncited, code/equation help), with syllabus advice and enforcement process. Same text as /instructional-resources/pedagogy/ai/classroom/ (byte-identical), so collected once.

documents.title: Ethical Use of Generative AI (thesis, dissertation, capstone, comprehensive exams)
documents.quality_note: Short but substantive Graduate School statement: disclosure to committee required, citation required, unauthorized use may violate Policy 1.8. Scope limited to graduate culminating work.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) at ISU
documents.quality_note: Mostly approved tools and data-classification rules (do not enter restricted data into Copilot); little teaching-and-learning policy.

notes: No ISU-wide AI policy document exists beyond the Student Code of Conduct academic integrity policy, which CIPD interprets; no standalone provost page found. Computing: no AI policy found for the School of Information Technology (searches returned nothing). Skipped: Spora journal AI policy (Elsevier journal policy, not teaching), research.illinoisstate.edu/ai-guidance (research-use guidance, not fetched into the corpus), artificialintelligence.illinoisstate.edu/using-ai-at-isu (tool list, generic). Committee for the Responsible Use of AI exists (about.illinoisstate.edu/ai/about/) but is governance description. Course syllabi deferred.
